requirements.research_statement: The original Search-vs-AI contract explicitly requires source-worthiness implication; Yandex recommends examining useful/expert/substantive competitor/source content and content gaps.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Compare decision-relevant GenSearch-used source content with the current target page and record source-worthiness/content-gap implications independently from architecture verdict.
requirements.required_artifact_field_or_output: source_worthiness_evidence; source_worthiness_implication; content_gap_vs_used_sources; content_improvement_state; content_improvement_action_if_any; content_claim_boundary
requirements.failure_policy: Missing source-worthiness implication blocks Step17 acceptance.
requirements.acceptance_check: 8/8 cases have a separately justified content/source-worthiness state

requirements.research_statement: Search-side task/type/format/angle should be derived from observed results and remain auditable to the underlying evidence, not only an upstream analyst summary.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Locate and cite concrete persisted ordinary-Search result artifacts/rows for each exact query and record which results drive the Step17 Search-side description.
requirements.failure_policy: If direct Search evidence cannot be recovered at sufficient fidelity, affected material verdict becomes blocked/INSUFFICIENT rather than relying only on Step15 prose.
requirements.claim_boundary: content type/format/angle are analyst/industry descriptors, not Yandex-native intent labels
requirements.acceptance_check: every Search-side material claim has a direct persisted evidence path

requirements.research_statement: Adversarial self-review and independent review are different controls and must not share labels unless independence is actually demonstrated.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Declare QA mode before review. Use ADVERSARIAL_SELF_REVIEW markers for same-process second pass; use INDEPENDENT_REVIEW markers only with an explicitly separate reviewer/process and recorded independence boundary.
requirements.claim_boundary: second pass != independent review by default
requirements.acceptance_check: QA terminology matches actual review execution

requirements.research_statement: Material architecture verdict and within-page content/source-worthiness implication are separate outputs.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Assign exactly one architecture/material verdict and separately assign one content-improvement state.
requirements.failure_policy: A case cannot pass with only one of the two result layers.
requirements.claim_boundary: DE_RISK/NO_CHANGE do not prove no content gap
requirements.acceptance_check: two-layer result complete for every case

requirements.research_statement: Method readiness requires complete forward and reverse trace from original step contract and external research into execution fields, final artifacts and QA.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Build an original-contract coverage table and verify every required Step17 output has a final field, evidence ref, claim boundary and QA check.
requirements.failure_policy: Any missing original requirement blocks Step17 PASS.

requirements.research_statement: Retain the corrected evidence boundaries from Step16 and the first Step17 preparation.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Keep exact-query, GenSearch-proxy, reproducibility and source-order boundaries active.
requirements.claim_boundary: GEN_SEARCH != CONSUMER_ALICE; EXACT_QUERY != USER_JOB_FAMILY; SINGLE_RUN != LONG_TERM_STABILITY; SOURCE_ORDER != RANK
